# bioexcel/biobb_io/alphafold

## Summary

This class is a wrapper for downloading a PDB structure from the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database.

Wrapper for the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database for downloading a single PDB structure from its corresponding Uniprot code.

Nextflow adapter of the [AlphaFold](https://biobb-io.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api.html#module-api.alphafold) building block of [biobb_io](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_io) 5.3.1.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_IO_ALPHAFOLD } from 'bioexcel/biobb_io/alphafold'

workflow {
    BIOBB_IO_ALPHAFOLD(channel.of([id: 'sample']))
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the output PDB file |
| `versions_biobb_io` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_io', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of AlphaFold properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_pdb_path: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_io container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_IO_ALPHAFOLD' {
        ext.properties = [remove_tmp: true]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uniprot_code` | string | null | Uniprot code. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
